stories.title: SBI campaign focuses on employees working during Diwali
stories.summary: State Bank of India has launched a Diwali campaign titled Ghar Se Dur, Ghar Wali Diwali. The film highlights individuals unable to return home for the festival due to work commitments. It aims to acknowledge essential workers and emphasize human connection over traditional festive themes.

stories.title: PNG Jewellers uses music for Diwali campaign
stories.summary: PNG Jewellers has launched a digital campaign titled Khushiyon Ki Sargam. The brand is using an all-female musical ensemble to perform an original composition based on the seven musical notes. The campaign aims to capture festive emotions through music rather than the traditional focus on jewellery.

stories.title: Campa Cola campaign highlights festive preparation
stories.summary: Campa Cola has launched a campaign titled Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big. Conceptualised by McCann India, the film shifts focus from final celebrations to the work involved in festive preparations. The brand positions itself as a companion during the everyday moments that bring people together.

stories.title: Oreo releases first holiday campaign in five years
stories.summary: Oreo has released its first seasonal campaign in five years. The spot features Santa Claus retaliating against a father who steals his cookies. The campaign was developed by No Notes Productions, the agency founded by Colin Jost. The brand generates approximately $3 billion in global revenue.

stories.title: In Oreo's First Holiday Ad in 5 Years, Cookie-Stealing Parents Land On Santa's Naughty List
stories.summary: Key Takeaways - Oreo's first holiday campaign in five years comes from No Notes Productions, the agency founded by SNL's Colin Jost. - The 30-second spot shows Santa retaliating against a father who steals his Oreos. - Oreo generates around $3 billion in global revenue

stories.title: David Schwimmer stars in Quince holiday campaign
stories.summary: David Schwimmer is appearing in a holiday campaign for fashion retailer Quince. The 60-second spot, titled The Red Sweater, references a plot twist from the sitcom Friends involving a red sweater. The episode originally aired in 2001, nearly 25 years before the advertisement was released.

stories.title: Prime Volleyball League launches anthem for season five
stories.summary: The Prime Volleyball League has launched the Udd Ke Maar campaign ahead of its fifth season. The campaign features an anthem and focuses on the attacking style of volleyball. The season is scheduled to take place from November 30 to December 27, 2026, in Ahmedabad.

stories.title: Himalaya BabyCare promotes winter skincare
stories.summary: Himalaya BabyCare has introduced a campaign for its Extra Moisturising Baby Soap. The brand highlights the importance of moisturising care for babies with dry or sensitive skin during the winter. The soap features an Aloe-Milk Moisture Complex designed to maintain skin comfort during daily bathing.

stories.title: Trans-Ocean promotes fish in the office
stories.summary: Seafood brand Trans-Ocean Products has partnered with influencer Ross Pomerantz for a campaign titled Bring Your Fish to Work. The company aims to challenge the perception that heating seafood in office microwaves is unwelcome. The campaign was developed following internal discussions that began in 2025.

stories.title: Pernod Ricard appoints Initiative as media agency
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard has appointed Initiative as its media agency partner for India and the Asia-Pacific region. The appointment follows a competitive review and covers nine markets. Initiative replaces Wavemaker, which held the mandate for over two decades in India and Singapore.

stories.title: Pernod Ricard names Initiative media agency for India and APAC
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard India has appointed Initiative, an Omnicom Media agency, as its media agency partner across nine markets in India and the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. The appointment follows a competitive review of the company's media mandate. The mandate covers India, China, Hong Kong, Japan, Taiwan,

stories.title: Burson announces senior leadership changes across APAC & the US
stories.summary: Global communications agency Burson has appointed Yuliani Setiadi as APAC head of Influence and Social and Davitha Tiller as US chair of the function, completing its regional leadership structure for the practice. Setiadi, who will be based in Singapore, joined Burson on November 4. She

stories.title: Omnicom Media wins Lufthansa global mandate
stories.summary: Omnicom Media has been appointed as the global media agency of record for Lufthansa Group. The five-year mandate begins January 1, 2027, and covers brand and performance media across multiple regions. The agency expects to manage approximately 10,000 active campaigns under the new partnership.

stories.title: Decathlon India returns to profitability
stories.summary: Decathlon India reported a net profit of Rs 63.23 crore for FY26, following a loss in the previous year. Revenue grew 8.35 percent to Rs 4,478.22 crore, while advertising and promotional expenditure fell 25.8 percent to Rs 66.11 crore. The company's total income crossed Rs 4,500 crore.

stories.title: Garage Worldwide appoints Siddharth Shah as ECD
stories.summary: Garage Worldwide has appointed Siddharth Shah as executive creative director. Based in Mumbai, Shah will lead the agency's creative output. He previously worked with agencies including FCB Ulka and BBH, and was part of the founding team at Spring Marketing Capital.

stories.title: Jeremy Latcham named president and CCO of DC Studios
stories.summary: Skydance Motion Picture Group has appointed former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham as president and chief creative officer of DC Studios, effective December 1. Latcham will oversee the studio's film, television, and animation slate. James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping away to return to creative work.

stories.title: Vishwajeet Sinha joins airtel as vice president of marketing
stories.summary: Vishwajeet Sinha has joined airtel as vice president of marketing. Sinha previously held roles at Flipkart, Meesho, Scapia, and Razorpay. The company describes the move as a meeting of a decade of scaling user bases with a brand that India has loved for years.

stories.title: Brand advertising remains a growth priority in India
stories.summary: Companies in India are increasing investments in brand advertising across sectors including technology, banking, and retail. The industry has expanded beyond traditional television and outdoor media to include digital storytelling, influencer collaborations, and experiential marketing to establish identities and build lasting relationships with customers in a competitive market.

stories.title: B2B marketing agencies shift toward precise targeting
stories.summary: The Indian B2B marketing landscape has matured as companies face longer sales cycles and independent buyer research. Agencies are moving away from broad awareness campaigns toward account-based approaches, marketing automation, and content designed to build technical credibility. Marketing activity is now expected to show clear pipeline linkage.

stories.title: Druski makes SNL debut
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Druski's recent appearance on Saturday Night Live is being cited as evidence that the creator economy has outgrown traditional social media platforms. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Druski signs multi-year Netflix deal
stories.summary: Comedy creator Druski has signed a multi-year deal to produce content exclusively for Netflix, beginning with a semi-scripted series titled Collect and Praise. The show is based on his viral megachurch sketch. Platforms are increasingly seeking ambitious scripted content from creators to capture their established audiences.

stories.title: Tubi competes for YouTube creator talent
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Tubi is reportedly winning Hollywood's war for YouTube creators by offering new distribution strategies for ambitious series. The platform is attracting creators who have built large audiences on YouTube but are looking for different ways to release their long-form content.

stories.title: Barstool Sports and Bob Does Sports host golf tournament
stories.summary: The second annual Internet Invitational, a team-based golf tournament featuring YouTube creators, has gained significant traction. The final round, filmed in Missouri, premieres on the Bob Does Sports YouTube channel. The event is currently being described as the best on-screen sports event available right now.

stories.title: YouTube prepares for Grand Theft Auto VI launch
stories.summary: YouTube is positioning itself as the destination for Grand Theft Auto VI content ahead of the game's November 19 release. The series has reached over 900 billion views on the platform to date, with pre-launch videos for the new title already accounting for 40 billion of those views.

stories.title: YouTube to host 24-hour livestream for GTA 6
stories.summary: YouTube will host a 24-hour broadcast to mark the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. The marathon begins at midnight on November 19, following a pre-show hosted by RDCWorld. The platform claims the launch deserves the biggest livestream, featuring creator podcasts and live gameplay throughout the day.

stories.title: TwitchCon faces questions over creator value
stories.summary: TwitchCon remains a significant event for brands, though some creators are questioning the cost and uncertain payoff of attending. Allegations regarding ticket distribution and lower attendance for top-performing partners have surfaced ahead of the event in San Diego. Twitch stated that its events have changed recently.

stories.title: Sony targets India's growing creator economy
stories.summary: Sony India is adjusting its imaging strategy to meet demand from the country's creator economy. Mukesh Srivastava, head of imaging business, noted that the company is focusing on AI-led camera innovations and integrated content creation workflows to engage emerging talent across Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.

stories.title: Creator management agencies face retention pressure
stories.summary: Competition is rising in India's creator management business as talent gains more representation options. While standard commissions hover around 20 percent, established creators are increasingly negotiating rates down to 15 percent. Agencies are finding that retaining top talent is now a greater challenge than securing brand partnerships.

stories.title: Wedding influencer rates rise as brand spending grows
stories.summary: Influencer rate cards for wedding-related content have seen a 20 to 25 percent surge as brands allocate over 50 lakh rupees to campaigns. Brands are using creators to enter consumer purchase journeys for jewellery, fragrance, and travel well before the actual wedding ceremonies begin.

stories.title: Hollywood looks to creator economy for audience data
stories.summary: Speakers at the American Film Market suggested that Hollywood is adopting creator-led strategies to validate projects before financing. By building an audience online first, studios aim to avoid the traditional model of investing heavily in ideas that have not yet demonstrated cultural relevance or consumer interest.

stories.title: Instagram tests financial incentives for long-form creators
stories.summary: Instagram is allowing videos up to 90 minutes and offering selected creators between 50,000 and 500,000 dollars to post longer content. The platform has not yet shared a concrete advertising model for these videos, leaving creators to weigh discovery potential against the lack of clear, sustainable income.

stories.title: Amazon faces scrutiny over advertising auction practices
stories.summary: The Federal Trade Commission has published unredacted details from a lawsuit accusing Amazon of secretly inflating advertising prices. The case highlights broader concerns regarding trust in AI-driven ad platforms, with similar allegations currently pending against Google. Amazon continues to encourage advertisers to trust its automated systems.

stories.title: TikTok updates AI video advertising tools
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. TikTok has introduced new updates to its suite of AI-powered video advertising tools, aimed at assisting marketers in content creation and campaign management. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Reddit offers seasonal ad credits to new advertisers
stories.summary: Reddit is offering new advertisers credits for campaigns launching before November 20, including 500 pounds for 1,000 pounds spent in the U.K. The platform is targeting Q4, the time of year when competition for budgets is fiercest. The incentives are currently being shared via email.

stories.title: Zefr expands ad measurement to CapCut and TikTok
stories.summary: Zefr has extended its advertising measurement tools to CapCut and TikTok's TopView ads, providing four separate metrics for each. The company also expanded coverage for TikTok image carousels and search inventory. Integral Ad Science announced similar capabilities for the same platforms on the same morning.

stories.title: Ads Uploader adds human approval for AI agents
stories.summary: Ads Uploader now allows agencies to review and approve edits made by AI agents before they go live on Meta. The company reports that AI agents launched over 108,000 ads in October 2026, starting nearly 3 in 10 of all campaigns. Human oversight is now an optional feature.

stories.title: Meta AI ads reportedly included unapproved discounts
stories.summary: Reports indicate that Meta's artificial intelligence-powered ad tools have been applying discount offers to customer campaigns even when those promotions were explicitly turned off by the advertiser. The issue stems from the platform's automated ad features.

stories.title: Japan flags AI privacy risks at major tech firms
stories.summary: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications has called for closer scrutiny of Google, LINE Yahoo, Meta and TikTok. A government working group found inconsistencies in how these companies handle data, explain privacy practices and allow user control, particularly regarding conversational AI and targeted advertising tools.

stories.title: Meta pauses updated business and ad terms
stories.summary: Meta has paused new business and ad terms that were scheduled to take effect on November 20. The company will continue operating under existing terms, which allow it to crawl advertiser websites for research and training purposes whenever an ad order is placed.

stories.title: X launches video clipping tool
stories.summary: X has introduced a video-trimming feature that allows users to edit longer videos into shorter clips for posting. Every clip includes a label linking back to the original video. The site describes the tool as an effort to make itself a friendlier hub for influencers.

stories.title: Nectar launches autonomous influencer marketing agent
stories.summary: Nectar has released an AI-powered platform designed to automate the entire influencer partnership workflow, from discovery to campaign execution. The company claims the agent can eliminate weeks of manual outreach and vetting. The tool is marketed as a way to handle partnership tasks without human intervention.

stories.title: AI influencers raise questions about digital likeness
stories.summary: Hyper-realistic AI-generated videos of historical figures, including Queen Elizabeth I, are appearing on TikTok. These figures are being used as content creators despite never having agreed to the use of their likeness. The trend has prompted questions regarding who owns a face in the age of AI.

stories.title: Yahoo licenses collective AI content model
stories.summary: Yahoo has become the first licensee of The Internet Licensing Collective, a model that allows publishers to get paid when their content is used in AI-powered search engines. The deal covers Yahoo's Scout search engine, moving away from the industry standard of one-off publisher deals.

stories.title: OpenAI enters search market
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. This report covers OpenAI's latest search product and its competitive impact on existing search platforms, alongside broader analysis of current tech industry news and executive developments.

stories.title: Industry leaders to headline MartechAI India Week
stories.summary: Global AI experts Allen Nejah and Christopher Allen are scheduled to lead the India Agentic AI, MarTech and CX Week 2027 in New Delhi this January. The event aims to bring together industry leaders to discuss AI-led innovation, data strategies and customer experience.

stories.title: AAAI appoints Prasad Shejale to lead AI council
stories.summary: The Advertising Agencies Association of India has formed a Council for AI, appointing LS Digital's Prasad Shejale as chair. The council intends to build AI capabilities across agencies, develop industry standards and represent the sector in discussions with regulators and technology platforms.

stories.title: Influur releases AI agent for music marketing
stories.summary: Influur has launched Pulse 2.0, an AI assistant designed to handle music influencer campaigns from outreach to payments. The company claims the tool allows label marketing teams to execute viral rollouts quickly, replacing the need for manual tracking across spreadsheets and individual inboxes.

stories.title: Influur launches Pulse 2.0 to automate influencer marketing
stories.summary: Influur has launched Pulse 2.0, an AI tool designed to handle influencer campaigns from a single prompt. The platform aims to remove manual work by researching creators, negotiating rates, and tracking performance. Users describe their objectives and budget, and the software generates a strategy. Spreadsheets are now optional.

stories.title: Tano raises $4 million to automate creator negotiations
stories.summary: London startup Tano has raised $4 million in a seed round led by Cherry Ventures, bringing its total funding to $5 million. The company claims its AI agents conduct 400,000 conversations with creators each month. The technology aims to replace manual email negotiations for brand deals.

stories.title: Progress Software advises fixing data before using AI
stories.summary: Sara Faatz, director of awareness at Progress Software, is urging marketing leaders to move past AI slop and improve foundational data before deploying generative tools. The full piece is for subscribers, but the advice suggests that data quality remains a prerequisite for effective automation.

stories.title: Ogilvy debuts ECHO platform for talent-approved AI content
stories.summary: Ogilvy has launched ECHO, an AI platform designed to scale creative content using verified talent scans. Developed with Creative Artists Agency, the system stores assets in a vault to address concerns regarding unauthorised deepfakes. Brands can now turn one shoot into multiple assets with explicit consent.
